The answer is **C (about $8k)**. Among the two options the team note allows, it is much closer to the historical estimates than A (about $300), which is far too low for 1850 America. My own recollection of Maddison-style series puts 1850 US GDP per capita around $4-5k in 2011 PPP dollars, so C is the nearer figure, though not a precise match.

CONFIDENCE: 60
